constraints.rule: Trail frames (plan, make, check, reflect, cycle-summary) MUST be written to .pmcro/trails/{cycle_id}/ immediately after every ACCEPT verdict. Do not defer trail writing until the next user message. Orchestrator writes trail before responding with the ACCEPT summary.

MAF (Microsoft.Agents.AI) is shipping minor versions every 2-4 days in the May 2026 period. At the start of every session, re-validate maf_version against NuGet before any code or documentation work begins. Do not assume the pinned version in identity.json is current.

Conversational/claude-web sessions must seal trails in the same GUID-folder + phase-JSONL (Planner/Maker/Checker/Reflector) + _sealed.json format used by the compiled Orchestrator, not as standalone seal.json/frame.md narrative files under trails/claude-web/. A recap describing an ACCEPT disposition is not itself a sealed trail. At least 5 prior claude-web trails (marketplace-consolidation, canonical-skills-and-pmcro-fold-in, engine-commands-resolution, marketplace-plugin-completion, pmcro-scaffold-scoping) violate this and are pending re-seal audit.
